[EN] Digging Dirt
[ES] Cavando la tierra
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thank you so much.
[ES] Muchas gracias.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill {@creature:47#4003#argonomorph gulas} north of the {@Rgn:47005$$Argon Frontier} and collect cyamonoid soil.
[ES] Mata {@creature:47#4003#argonomorph gulas} al norte del {@Rgn:47005$$Argon Frontier} y recoge tierra de ciamonoide.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I will."
[ES] "Lo haré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect cyamonoid soil.
[ES] Recoge tierra de ciamonoide.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the cyamonoid soil to {@creature:247#1021$$Shannow}.
[ES] Entrégale la tierra de ciamonoide a {@creature:247#1021$$Shannow}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Happy to help."
[ES] "Un placer ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to {@Rgn:77001$$Pathfinder Post} and tell {@creature:77#1009$$Borskan} about the black dirt.
[ES] Ve a {@Rgn:77001$$Pathfinder Post} y cuéntale a {@creature:77#1009$$Borskan} sobre la tierra negra.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
